OWNER DECISIONS 2026-10-01 (in chat) on pilot-runner design fc698d6e:
- O1: one global pooled AR(1) from a common FIR pre-fit for ALL arms, PHRF included. This is declared as a protocol deviation, with a voxelwise-AR sensitivity arm after the pilot.
- O7: custodian is backlog-worker-20260930, with a separate reviewer of the runner (distinct from custodian and authors).
- O2-O6, O8, O9: design defaults accepted (stimulus-level held-out predicted R2 LOROCV score; 40 voxels + 4000 pool; four ICC targets; primary refusal rule only; root = first 8 bytes of SHA-256(v0 hash || drand beacon A); R parity before the campaign; new modules/phrf-comparison module).
